experiment: Budget-preserving dictionary contour compilation; matched moves and matched logical work caps

corpus.generator: Fisher-Yates corner/edge permutations; parity correction; constrained independent orientations. Pseudorandom legal-state sampling, not a scramble-length proxy.
corpus.role: Separate from the 200-scramble development corpus; reused for verification, not claimed to be an independently held-out or preregistered study.

protocol.timing: performance.now around solve; includes input decode and internal replay, excludes setup and external sticker replay
protocol.statistic: median per instance across repeats, then corpus median / nearest-rank P95
protocol.order: rotating configurations and alternating corpus direction
protocol.confidenceInterval: 2000 seeded paired-instance bootstrap resamples; hardware/runtime conditional; not cross-device uncertainty
